RiderProfile.title: RiderProfile
RiderProfile.description: Authenticated gig delivery rider profile, vehicle metadata, INR wallet balance, and voice alert preference.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the rider.

voiceAlertsEnabled.description: Whether hands-free Gemini TTS voice alerts are enabled.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when profile was last updated.

TripRecord.title: TripRecord
TripRecord.description: Individual delivery trip micro-insurance cover record with live GPS start/end coordinates and coverage limits.

coverageLimitInr.description: Maximum medical/accident cover limit in INR.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when trip cover started.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when trip was last updated.

endedAt.description: Optional server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when trip cover ended.

ClaimRecord.title: ClaimRecord
ClaimRecord.description: Incident claim submitted by a rider with optional GPS pin, photo evidence flag, and AI policy advisor summary.

tripId.description: Linked trip document ID or OUTSIDE_TRIP.

evidenceAttached.description: Whether rider attached a photo via Android Photo Picker.

aiSummary.description: Optional Gemini High-Thinking eligibility assessment summary.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when claim was filed.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when claim was updated.

LedgerEntry.title: LedgerEntry
LedgerEntry.description: Immutable INR financial ledger entry for trip premiums, claim payouts, and wallet top-ups.

referenceCode.description: Monospace trip or claim code reference.

amountInr.description: Signed INR amount (negative for premium debit, positive for top-up/payout).

balanceAfterInr.description: Wallet balance in INR immediately after this entry.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when entry was recorded.

/users/{userId}.description: Authenticated rider profile and INR wallet summary.

/users/{userId}/claims/{claimId}.description: Rider-owned incident claims and AI eligibility summaries.

/users/{userId}/ledger/{entryId}.description: Immutable rider INR premium, payout, and top-up ledger entries.
